name: bulk-domain-availability-checker
title: Check 1,000 Startup Name Ideas at Once (DNS + RDAP)
description: Check 1,000 startup-name ideas at once: names x TLDs, a fast DNS pre-check and a confirmation from the registry's RDAP server. Per domain: available or registered, registrar, creation and expiry dates, and a parked or for-sale flag. Unknown TLDs are rejected, never reported as available. Paste domains or keywords. Export CSV, Excel or JSON, or run from the API.
seoTitle: Startup Name Checker: 1,000 Domain Ideas at Once
seoDescription: Check 1,000 startup-name ideas across TLDs at once. DNS pre-check, RDAP confirmation, registrar and expiry dates, for-sale flag. No API keys.
